Actors Vishal Aditya Singh and Asim Riaz exchange social media barbs

Actors Vishal Aditya Singh and Asim Riaz engaged in a public dispute on social media. Vishal Aditya Singh responded to a direct comment made by Asim Riaz, advising him to "keep calm" and say "Jai Shri Ram." Singh also made a remark about injections and building bodies, seemingly in response to Riaz's comments.
